literal_meaning: ঝড় এবং ঝাপটা (ঝড়োয়ামো বা ঝড়ের ঝাপটা)
figurative_meaning_en: hardships and adversities; troubles and turmoils in life
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় এই ঝড়ঝাপটা পার করতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I've endured many storms and stresses in life.
We have to weather this storm and turmoil in business.
note: This is a reduplicative expression common in colloquial Bengali to describe life's challenges.
